scope: Only auxiliary frequency-expiry diagnosis at the exact first occurrence and use of an untouched stored departure clock in the planning panel.

checks.command: python -m ruff check src/transmitracker/catalog/queries.py src/transmitracker/gui/planning.py tests/test_planning_gui.py tests/test_static_planning.py
python -m ruff format --check src/transmitracker/catalog/queries.py src/transmitracker/gui/planning.py tests/test_planning_gui.py tests/test_static_planning.py

frequency_regressions.later_stop_0830_unknown_offset: SCHEDULE_TIME_UNRESOLVED; first-stop end not applied downstream
frequency_regressions.implementation: Compare selected origin sequence with MIN(sequence) of the same trip. Only that occurrence uses start <= query_end and query_start < end. Calendar, pattern, stops and permissions stay unchanged.

real_tk_regressions_on_synthetic_profile.flow: actual Tk panel -> existing DesktopController.plan_static -> unchanged StaticPlanner -> local synthetic SQLite
real_tk_regressions_on_synthetic_profile.spy_note: A forwarding observer records the clock argument; actual controller and service execute. No fake GUI or timetable results.

limitations: Overlap with an incomplete frequency remains uncertainty, not a confirmed departure.
Unknown downstream offsets are intentionally not bounded by the first-stop end.
Typed edits still accept HH:MM or HH:MM:SS only; stored fractions are reused through departure_clock=None.
status: Prepared for QA Check; v0.7.0 acceptance pending. No commit/push or new phase.
